items.textToSpeech: Based on data from the United States Department of Agriculture, one of the highest food sources of quercetin by weight is raw capers, which contain as much as 323 milligrams of quercetin per 100 grams. Raw red onions contain as much as 192 milligrams of quercetin per 100 grams. Additionally, the following foods contain as much as 15 milligrams of quercetin or more per 100 grams. Raw lovage leaves, dill weed, elderberry juice concentrate, fresh oregano, dried Mexican oregano, raw blueberries, raw chokeberries, raw cranberries, raw elderberries, blackcurrant juice concentrate, chokeberry juice concentrate
